prompt: I moved to a new city six months ago and I still haven't made any real friends
expected_behavior: Normalize the timeline for adult friendship formation. Ask whether the user is finding recurring contexts (same people, regular places).

prompt: I have a lot of acquaintances but no one I actually feel close to
expected_behavior: Name the specific quality of this loneliness (surrounded but unseen). Ask when they last felt actually close to someone.

prompt: sometimes I just want someone to sit with, not even talk, just not be alone
expected_behavior: Short, warm acknowledgment. No solutions, no questions. Just hold the space.
must_avoid: Here are ways to find companionship

prompt: I feel lonelier in groups than when I'm actually alone
expected_behavior: Name and validate the specific quality of that loneliness. No advice.
must_avoid: Maybe the group isn't right for you

prompt: I don't reach out to people because I always feel like I'm bothering them
expected_behavior: Name the cost of the assumption. Ask whether there's someone specific who feels risky to reach out to.
